prompt: Review a redesign whose sections look polished but become indistinguishable from generic SaaS templates when the header/logo is cropped. Propose a brand-distinctiveness system and QA method without reducing usability.
expected_outcomes: Defines multiple repeatable brand-linked cues beyond logo/color
Balances distinctive expression with familiar controls
Uses cropped-screen review as heuristic rather than fake standardized score
must_not: Solve recognition by repeating logos everywhere
Claim a numeric recognition rate without testing
Add trendy effects unrelated to brand source-of-truth
